answers.core: As there are still quite a few people in 3.X waiting to jump over to Godot 4.x, removing friction with a (seemingly?) easy fix could help more people transition to the future of Godot.
answers.workaround: Work around with going through all capsuleshapes in project. Depending on the project these can be many or few.

title: Autoadjust CapsuleShape2D when upgrading to 4.x from 3.x.
